pages.text: The $(bold)Energy Cell Serializer$(reset) combines 26 energy cells into one battery.$(br2)$(bold)Formation:$(reset) place the serializer in the centre and 26 energy cells (any tier) around it to fill a 3×3×3 shell; connect a pipe to any shell cell to charge or drain the whole structure.$(br2)$(bold)Total storage = 10 billion base + 26 × each cell's capacity$(reset). With Super cells this is 26 × 20 billion + 10 billion, approximately $(bold)521 billion$(reset) AE.$(br2)The Infinite Cell is a creative-only debug item and is not obtainable in survival.

The Serializer combines $(l:akaishi:energy_cell)Energy Cells$(/l). Connect it to a $(l:akaishi:generator)Generator$(/l) or $(l:akaishi:gen_matrix)Generator Matrix$(/l) through $(l:akaishi:energy_pipe)Energy Pipes$(/l).
